title: Egg video as helicopter sling load

tellings.quote: I think it's probably something larger. I think it might actually be from a helicopter and it might be something being moved.

plain: Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, debates a guest named Merrick on Jesse Michels' podcast about a 2025 video of an egg-shaped object, tied to claims by a man named Jake Barber and the journalist Ross Coulthart. West says he thinks the object is probably larger than it looks and may be a load hanging beneath a helicopter while being moved. If so, the video would show ordinary cargo rather than a strange craft.
